_spec: Sign-dictation contract v1 — the recognition sibling of face/body contracts. Executed by sdk/recognition/sign-recognizer.js. Same load-bearing invariant: positions never cross the boundary. The featurizer (sign-landmarks.js) re-expresses every landmark in a signer-normalized frame (mid-shoulder origin, torso scale, aspect-corrected) before anything downstream sees it; what crosses to sinks is glosses, confidences, and dimensionless measures. The classifier itself is a MODEL ASSET named here, never committed to git — train/serve landmark distributions must match, so the model URL is version-locked to the tracker pin below.

human.tracker_pin: @mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.18 + the exact .task model URLs in sdk/core/tracking.js — NEVER bump without re-extracting training landmarks (distribution shift silently eats accuracy)
human.tracker_call: initTracking(vid, { numHands: 2, raw: true, poseEvery: 2, enableFace: false, poseModel: POSE_MODELS.full })
human.smoothing: NONE before the classifier — raw:true is mandatory (the deadband stabilizer quantizes slow motion and corrupts velocity features); the model trains on raw landmark noise instead
human.feature_layout: 51 points x (x,y) = 102: handL[0..20] + handR[21..41] + pose[nose,shoulders,elbows,wrists,hips]. NaN for missing, zeroed at window assembly. Anatomical L/R via tracking.js handedness.

window.note: fixed ONNX shape — pad+mask, never dynamic axes

calibration_ritual: rest: 2s hands-down hold -> per-user idle energy floor (tunes stop_energy)
reach: touch signing-space corners -> per-user signing-space extent (future channel cal)

model.training_plan: M1 fingerspelling (Kaggle corpus, prototype-only license); M2 250-sign shipped model retrained on PopSign ASL v1.0 (CC-BY 4.0) with landmarks re-extracted by the pinned tracker above

channels.meaning: one recognized gloss per closed segment, confidence-gated; below min_conf emits 'lowconf' instead (never a silent wrong caption)
